Oil Cap (Air-Vent)

Oil Cap (Air-Vent)

This product releases the internal pressure generated by oil splash in machine tool gearboxes and crankcases through an air vent hole, preventing oil leaks and seal damage.
The air hole does not clog even after prolonged use.
Available in two types: PF-thread and M-thread.
